title: Positive-coordinate count on a set
statement: For a finite set $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$ and a sign vector $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$, the positive-coordinate count on $S$ is the number of indices $i\in S$ for which $x_i=1$.
